text:
maria gonzalez: Quick idea — we need a compact flow in the Console for automatic fallback that lets ops pick a 'soft defer' window (e.g., 30s, 2m) before switching degrade modes, and shows a concise audit line explaining reason. Attached mock (https://redwood.mock/designs/soft-defer).
ken li: What's the primary trigger? error-rate only or latency/queue-depth too?
olga petrov: Prefer multi-signal. error_rate > 5% OR p95 latency > 600ms for X secs. Also want 'reason tags' in audit: e.g., "model_unreachable", "high_latency", "quota_exhausted".
maria gonzalez: Agreed. UX thought: the Console shows active trigger, sampled request IDs (click to replay), and a one-click 'force-fallback' with TTL and operator note.
samir rao: Can we include a small 'replay sample' button that opens the eval harness with the exact prompt+ctx? Helps SRE debug regressions.
olga petrov: Yes — but need RBAC: only rollout-ops or devs can force fallback. Also log operator note into event stream.
ken li: For policy authoring, propose JSON-ish template in the UI. e.g.
```
{
  "name": "soft-defer-fallback",
  "triggers": ["error_rate", "p95_latency"],
  "window": "30s",
  "tags": ["model_unreachable"],
  "operator_ttl": "10m"
}
```
maria gonzalez: Nice. Also add 'audit preview' that shows past 5 instances where this rule would've fired (dry-run) — important before enabling auto-rollout.
samir rao: Telemetry: record decision hash, signal snapshots, sample request ids + model variant used. Make them linkable from the audit entry.
olga petrov: Edge-case: what if fallback causes worse quality? We need a 'safety-sla' check that prevents fallback if client has opted-in quality_constrained tag.
ken li: Could do policy priority: fallback only if safety_sla_pass==true OR operator_bypass.
deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout-service v2.14.0
maria gonzalez: thanks — I'll sketch a compact mock and share in design channel. Any objections to adding a short 'why' field in audit that accepts free-text (operator or system)?
samir rao: +1. Also add email/Slack notify toggle when auto-fallback flips production routes.
olga petrov: +1. OK to prototype this week.
